exposure: Indications for cesarean section (fetal bradycardia with distress, maternal request)
outcome: Prevalence of cesarean sections performed under general anesthesia
cohort: The study included all cesarean sections performed at a tertiary care center between April 14, 2013, and April 13, 2023.
finding: The prevalence of cesarean sections under general anesthesia at a tertiary care center over a decade was 2.98%, with most being emergency procedures primarily due to fetal distress, and a notable proportion involving primigravida and nulliparous women.
mod_finding: General anesthesia was used in 2.98% of cesarean sections, with the majority of these specific mode of birth procedures being emergency cases mainly due to fetal distress, and often occurring in primigravida and nulliparous women.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively for cesarean sections performed between April 14, 2013, and April 13, 2023.
